claims.title: Marginal Path Collapse exists
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Construct a Gaussian witness with positive endpoint precision, negative intermediate precision, and a divergent truncated log-normalizer.
claims.limitation: Concrete Gaussian witness; finite corroboration does not re-prove the general theorem.

claims.title: Path Existence Criterion
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Compare the scalar Gaussian precision sign with independent quadrature over 60 seeded cases and compare analytic normalizers.
claims.limitation: Finite one-dimensional Gaussian calibration; the universal theorem remains theorem-level.

claims.title: ACE correction
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Apply two time-varying exponent bumps to collapsed paths and check positivity plus endpoint preservation.
claims.limitation: Two constructive instances, not a finite proof of every theorem case.

claims.title: Synthetic W1/W2/MMD table
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Audit exact replay, CPU reconstruction, independent resource/metric feasibility, and assumption-preserving falsification.
claims.limitation: Exact checkpoints/samples and an authorized CUDA or author-validated CPU path are unavailable.

claims.title: CrossDock-Weak table
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Audit exact protocol/assets, released benchmark identity, independent molecule metrics, and assumption-preserving falsification.
claims.limitation: Exact nine-task assets, generated molecules, and authorized Linux/CUDA execution are unavailable.

claims.title: Collapse fraction versus guidance
claims.how_claim_is_produced: Enumerate all 125 ordered schedule triplets, retain the 100 eligible cases, and independently recheck all classifications on a 20,001-point grid.
claims.limitation: Exact finite Appendix E.2 domain only; no extrapolation to other schedules.
